name: woocommerce-back-in-stock-notifications-migrator
title: Back In Stock Notifications Migrator for WooCommerce
description: Moves Back In Stock Notifications data into WooCommerce Core's built-in stock notifications.

scripts.env:dev:restart: pnpm run wp-env destroy --force && pnpm run wp-env start --update
scripts.test:php:env: pnpm run wp-env:test run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/back-in-stock-notifications-migrator-for-woocommerce -- env WP_TESTS_DIR=/wordpress-phpunit WC_CORE_DIR=/var/www/html/woocommerce-source/plugins/woocommerce php vendor/bin/phpunit --fail-on-empty-test-suite
scripts.test:php:env:multisite: pnpm run wp-env:test run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/back-in-stock-notifications-migrator-for-woocommerce -- env WP_MULTISITE=1 WP_TESTS_DIR=/wordpress-phpunit WC_CORE_DIR=/var/www/html/woocommerce-source/plugins/woocommerce php vendor/bin/phpunit --fail-on-empty-test-suite
